Name: Flight Controller
Description: Main microcontroller for flight control, sensor data processing, and motor command generation via WiFi.

Name: Gyro/Accelerometer
Description: Provides 6-axis motion data (3-axis gyroscope, 3-axis accelerometer) for flight stabilization.

Name: Front Left Motor
Description: Brushed DC motor for propulsion (front left arm).

Name: Front Right Motor
Description: Brushed DC motor for propulsion (front right arm).

Name: Rear Left Motor
Description: Brushed DC motor for propulsion (rear left arm).

Name: Rear Right Motor
Description: Brushed DC motor for propulsion (rear right arm).

Name: FL Motor MOSFET ESC
Description: N-channel MOSFET acting as a low-side switch for Front Left motor speed control via PWM.

Name: FR Motor MOSFET ESC
Description: N-channel MOSFET acting as a low-side switch for Front Right motor speed control via PWM.

Name: RL Motor MOSFET ESC
Description: N-channel MOSFET acting as a low-side switch for Rear Left motor speed control via PWM.

Name: RR Motor MOSFET ESC
Description: N-channel MOSFET acting as a low-side switch for Rear Right motor speed control via PWM.

Name: Main LiPo Battery
Description: Single cell Lithium Polymer battery providing main power for the drone.

Name: Main Drone Frame
Description: Lightweight 3D-printed frame integrating motor arms, flight controller mount, battery tray, and ESC mounting points.

Name: FL CW Propeller
Description: Clockwise rotating propeller for the front-left motor.

Name: FR CCW Propeller
Description: Counter-clockwise rotating propeller for the front-right motor.

Name: RL CCW Propeller
Description: Counter-clockwise rotating propeller for the rear-left motor.

Name: RR CW Propeller
Description: Clockwise rotating propeller for the rear-right motor.

Name: M2x6mm Screws
Description: Small screws for mounting electronics to the 3D-printed frame.

Name: Battery Velcro Strap
Description: Used to secure the LiPo battery to the drone frame.
